verdict.rationale: Reading a platform's source under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS/CLI developer platform like Manufact, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows the product's source is published or licensed openly. The GitHub mentions concern deploying users' own repositories and templates. The references to mcp-use (a v2 release and run.mcp-use.com URLs) never state a license or a public source repository for Manufact itself.
